_: The retention agent's ledger (learning piece 7): each closed week read, its next-day return and verdict; each proposal and its verdict. Written by tools/agents/retention.mjs record and by the agent's PRs.

proposals.hypothesis: Launch weeks (Sudoku, ¡Al toque!) pulled one-off play to the new game and nothing called players back the next day; a morning reminder to yesterday's players restores next-day return.
proposals.action: push: morning 'Your Uno al día is ready' to subscribed players who played the day before (panel 📣)
proposals.verdictRule: worked if next-day return (any game) >= 59.3% both weeks after it ships; secondary Uno al día d1
